faq.a1: Yes! BookConv is completely free to use with no registration required. Free users get 5 conversions per hour with up to 10 MB file size.
faq.a2: BookConv supports 17+ ebook formats including EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, HTML, FB2, LIT, CBR, DJVU, JPG, PNG, and Word documents.
faq.q3: Is my data safe when I upload files?
faq.a3: Absolutely. All files are transferred over encrypted HTTPS connections and automatically deleted within 1 hour after conversion. We never read, store, or share your content.
faq.q4: Do I need to install any software?
faq.a4: No! BookConv runs entirely in your browser. Simply upload your file, select the output format, and download your converted file — no software installation needed.
faq.q5: Can I convert Kindle books to EPUB?
faq.a5: Yes! BookConv supports converting AZW3 and MOBI (Kindle formats) to EPUB and other formats. Simply upload your Kindle file and choose your desired output format.

privacy.title: Your Privacy & Security

secure.title: Encrypted Transfers
secure.desc: All files are transferred over HTTPS with end-to-end encryption. We use industry-standard TLS 1.3 to protect your data in transit.

delete.title: Automatic Deletion Within 1 Hour
delete.desc: Converted files are automatically deleted from our servers within 1 hour after conversion. This applies to all users regardless of plan — we don't store your books.

no-store.title: We Never Store Your Files
no-store.desc: Files are processed in memory and deleted immediately after conversion completes. No backups, no archives, no exceptions.

no-read.title: We Don't Read Your Content
no-read.desc: Our automated conversion engine processes files without human review. No person at BookConv reads, analyzes, or distributes your ebook content.

privacy.footer: For more details, see our [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
